scientific_scope: Ni/PyBOX 去芳构化环加成机制、绝对构型、选择性物理来源及与实验强度的有界比较。

required_numerical_evidence.description: 实际结合、开环/闭合或等效形成机制的关键态能量与活化量。
required_numerical_evidence.public_requirement: Computed key-state energies and activation requirements supporting binding and the proposed ring-opening/closure or equivalent product-formation mechanism.

required_numerical_evidence.description: 正确构型映射下 R/S 竞争的实际 Gibbs 活化量及 ΔΔG‡。
required_numerical_evidence.public_requirement: Computed R/S Gibbs activation energies and ΔΔG‡ for the correctly mapped competing configurations.

required_numerical_evidence.description: 支撑所选物理解释的实际 R/S 结构/电子分析数据，例如距离、角度、形变或相互作用量；按论断选择，不指定唯一分解算法。
required_numerical_evidence.public_requirement: Computed R/S structural or electronic data supporting the chosen physical explanation, such as contact distances, angles, deformation or interaction quantities; choose data appropriate to the claim, with no mandatory decomposition algorithm.

final_outcomes.description: 催化开环与去芳构化闭环的解释
目标饱和 CH 的 R 偏好
选择性的有证据分子起源
模型富集与实验 er 的关系

verification_support: 正文 Table 1 entry 6/Scheme 6D、SI S126–130；历史验证支持结合/开环与两支闭环、R 构型，以及局部弱接触和形变/相互作用分解的有界解释。
boundaries: 限定 Ni(OTf)2/(S,S)-tBuPyBOX/CHCl3，不能混入另一镍盐、配体或 DCM 数据。
验证的 +1 triplet 是重建模型，不是原卡已公开或全溶液物种的唯一答案。
R 侧若干局部接触增强，但吸引子域积分及总相互作用分解可偏 S；不把“所有 R 吸引更强”硬化成答案。
代表 TS 预测的富集强度与实验同向但非精确一致；不设 er/ΔΔG 容差。
source_locator: Main PDF p.3 Table 1 entry 6 and pp.5–6 Scheme 6D/discussion; supplementary_001 PDF/S pp.126–130, chiral-method paragraph, Figs.S3–S5 and Table S6.
whole_case_success: All required_for_success outcomes must pass for whole-case success; each supported independent outcome retains its weighted points if other outcomes fail.
